authority: Root already authorized CPU implementation; this review does not authorize GPU, submission or promotion.

coverage_clarification.additional_path: The modified shared pooler config also generates ordinary FUSE=false TOKR16 PK=false and PK=true.
coverage_clarification.shared_pointer_detail: B32 pooler and C32 QKV have identical compile-time template values in both PK variants; runtime N and prepared pmax differ, so both resource cases remain necessary.
coverage_clarification.uv_identity: UV mode is a runtime TArgs field, not a distinct compiled template.
coverage_clarification.status: Actual generated draft source independently enumerated; complete frozen source still pending.
coverage_clarification.correction: Initial review incorrectly called all14 resource cases distinct compiled pointers; corrected after actual generated-template enumeration.

required_source_gates: Uniform eight-piece router reduction in every FUSE specialization and both scratch allocation sites; no four-piece counter user.
Device, host and Python agree on FUSE ring padding using max(WBY,WBYR), with actual transaction sizes unchanged.
All actual prepared target pmax values and reachable PK pointers preflight outside tuner exception handling; missing prepared target state is not coverage.
Actual CUDA API success, localSizeBytes=0 and occupancy gates for exact pointers; no register cap or algorithm fallback.
FUSE32 compatibility capacity1 is allowed only with unambiguous offline proof it was absent from selected timed profiles.
Unchanged PDL placement, escape stage handbacks, cbar/named barriers, UV lifetimes, compiler options and unrelated device sources.
Actual-source CPU proofs followed by frozen full diff critique and root rerun before any official check.

promotion_gate_review.method: 46/16 weighted per-load speedups, six-load geometric aggregate; four affected-load GM and two control-load GM separately.
promotion_gate_review.claims: Provisional measured improvement only. Report confidence overlap and provenance; no significance or speed forecast.

limitations: This is a plan review, not a review of a completed candidate.
Actual register allocation, occupancy and speed remain unknown.
The profile-based potential estimates are scenarios, not upper bounds or forecasts.
CPU publication-order models cannot prove GPU memory ordering.
